hashing_method.rule: Every digest is a full 64-character SHA-256 of content bytes. A git object id is never a digest.

Git-tracked text files: SHA-256 of the bytes printed by `git show PIN:path` (LF as stored, independent of working-tree line endings). WAV files, binaries and other private evidence: SHA-256 of the raw file bytes. Native candidate package-lock.json: `git show 553dd9080f452f8a54ccff5cd5fea8d6937438ae:package-lock.json`.

rule_8_credit_treatment.text: TIMING-INCONCLUSIVE unit: no credit in the conservative bound, may be credited in the best-case bound, so Layer A is INCONCLUSIVE rather than FAIL when the verdict depends on it. See v3a amendment rule 8.

rule_6_capture_check.text: A scored word overlapping a recorded gap, overlap or overrun is verified from the decoded recording (5 ms frames on both sides of each event before the measured end, and the acoustic end inside the supported interval); otherwise CAPTURE-LIMITED: uncredited in both bounds, in the denominator, counts toward INDETERMINATE, never FAILURE OBSERVED. See v3a amendment rule 6.

known_limitations: Steps below the combined anchor uncertainty are undetectable.
Route bias (VB-CABLE, loopback) is not simulated.
A timing-excluded unit that cannot be placed at all stays timing-INCONCLUSIVE without a capture check.
Matcher-output binding does not detect coordinated edits made before sealing.

run_binding.limits: run-scored-run.ps1 has been parse-checked only. The verifier cannot see which scripts a process actually launches; it checks that every tracked script under scripts/gate3-retest is pinned and that the tree is clean at the pin.
run_binding.approved_hash: verify-against-manifest.py requires --approved-manifest-sha256 (orchestrator: -ApprovedManifestSha256). It hashes the manifest after normalizing CRLF to LF, which equals the committed blob bytes, and exits non-zero on any difference. The orchestrator passes it on both runs and records it in run-record.txt.
